date.as_written: समत् ५२७ वैशाषमास्य गुरुकूपचे चतुर्दश्यांतिथौ चिन्तानचत्रे वजयोगे ... बृहस्पति – वार

place.normalized: Kathmandu, Mānadeva-saṃskārita Cakra Mahāvihāra (Cuka Bāhā / Cakra-vihāra)

notes: Bendall's catalogue header misreads or misprints the date as 'N. s. 926 (A.D. 1806)', whereas the text itself reads 'समत् ५२७' (samvat 527 = c. 1407 CE). The scribe's name 'ज्ञाजणग्लन' is marked as doubtful with (?) by Bendall.
